title: Dometic 22 oz Tumbler, Frost

comparisons.notes: Exact match Dometic Tumbler 650 (22 oz / 650 ml) in Frost, MPN 97000071438; in stock as a special-order item with a 3-5 week lead time

writeup: Woot has the Dometic 22 oz Tumbler in Frost, new, for $17.99. Nomadic Supply sells the exact same Frost tumbler (MPN 97000071438) for $34.99, and Dometic's own store charges the same for the 22 oz size, so this is 48% less. It's a copper-lined, double-wall vacuum insulated steel tumbler with a magnetic flip cap that stays open while you sip. Only one was left when we checked, with a limit of three per customer.
